long_biography.plain_text:
A serious heart illness redirected William Demarest Johnson from investment management into film production and regenerative medicine. After receiving experimental stem-cell treatment, he founded Demarest Films, bringing an asset-management discipline to screen financing. He produced or financed more than twenty features, including Hacksaw Ridge, and served as an executive producer of the television miniseries The Night Manager.

In Thailand, Johnson immersed himself in regenerative-medicine services. He established RenewyouAsia and Demarest Clinic in Phuket, assembling an international medical advisory board around cellular therapies and treatments for age-related conditions. His ownership and chief-executive role placed him at the operational centre of the business, while his public writing explained how his own treatment experience shaped its purpose. He continues to represent the clinic as its founder.
